presets.name: Drum bleed
presets.description: Lets each hit through and turns the bleed down 30 dB, not to silence, so the kit stays natural.

presets.name: Tight kick
presets.description: Closes fast between kicks; listens only to the lows, so the snare doesn't open it.

presets.name: Snare room cut
presets.description: Shortens the snare's room; ignores the kick below 150 Hz.

presets.name: Tom cleanup
presets.description: Silences a tom microphone between fills, with a long, natural tail.

presets.name: Hi-hat tidy
presets.description: Turns a hi-hat microphone's bleed down; listens only above 3 kHz.

presets.name: Vocal noise
presets.description: Turns the room down 20 dB between phrases, slowly enough not to clip breaths.

presets.name: Breath control
presets.description: An expander that lowers breaths and noise gradually rather than cutting them.

presets.name: Gentle expander
presets.description: Turns quiet parts down a little more, for a cleaner sound with no audible gating.

presets.name: Guitar amp hiss
presets.description: Takes an amp's hiss out between notes.

presets.name: Bass DI cleanup
presets.description: Silences a direct bass between notes.

presets.name: Trance gate (sidechain)
presets.description: Choose a rhythmic track under Sidechain: this one plays only when it does.

presets.name: Flip, room only
presets.description: Takes the hits out and keeps the room between them.
